long_biography.plain_text:
Hogan has placed Della Valle close to product and brand development. As the label's president, he has treated innovation as a continuing priority, including experiments that connected Italian-made casual footwear with digital retail. His preparation in the United States preceded a long tenure as vice chairman and managing director of the wider Tod's business.

The family's industrial path began with Filippo Della Valle's workshop and continued when Andrea's father, Dorino, developed it into a small manufacturer. Diego drove later expansion, while Andrea supplied executive stewardship and ownership alongside him. Their 2024 agreement with L Catterton and LVMH took Tod's private while leaving family control in place. Earlier, Andrea chaired ACF Fiorentina during its recovery from bankruptcy, extending his management experience beyond fashion.

Operator is more precise than Founder because Filippo Della Valle established the original workshop and Diego is identified as Tod's founder in corporate filings. It is more precise than Heir / family shareholder because Andrea has long held executive authority and continues to lead Hogan.
